comparison.objective: Install a three-pin comb busbar into a row of breaker terminals and tighten every terminal.
comparison.physical_skill: Sequential screw loosening, simultaneous multi-pin alignment/insertion, and torque-tool use.
comparison.success_condition: All pins home and square, all screws clamp their pins, comb resists a 10 N pull, screwdriver down and hands clear for 2 s.
comparison.reason: Simultaneous multi-pin insertion and fastening do not test continuous rail-like support or retention of freely moving internal bearing elements.
